import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long capacity, flow;
        long cost;
        Edge(int u, int v, long capacity, long flow, long cost) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
        long remaining() {
            return capacity - flow;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
    static ArrayList<Edge> edges;
    static long[] dist;
    static int[] parent;
    static long[] bottleNeck;
    static boolean[] inQ;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static void connect(int u, int v, long cap, long cst) {
        adj[u].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cst));
        adj[v].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cst));
    }

    static void minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t, int totalNodes) {
        Arrays.fill(inQ, false);
        long totalFlow = 0;
        long totalCost = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            parent[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(bottleNeck, 0);
            bottleNeck[s] = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            inQ[s] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inQ[u] = false;
                for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                    if (e.remaining() > 0 && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + e.cost + 1e-9) {
                        dist[e.v] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        parent[e.v] = idx;
                        bottleNeck[e.v] = Math.min(bottleNeck[u], e.remaining());
                        if (!inQ[e.v]) {
                            q.offer(e.v);
                            inQ[e.v] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[t] < 0) break;
            long flowAdd = bottleNeck[t];
            totalFlow += flowAdd;
            totalCost += flowAdd * dist[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = edges.get(parent[v]).u) {
                edges.get(parent[v]).flow += flowAdd;
                edges.get(parent[v] ^ 1).flow -= flowAdd;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(totalCost);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int maxNodes = 6 + 107 * n;
        adj = new ArrayList[maxNodes];
        for (int i = 0; i < maxNodes; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        edges = new ArrayList<>();
        dist = new long[maxNodes];
        parent = new int[maxNodes];
        bottleNeck = new long[maxNodes];
        inQ = new boolean[maxNodes];

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            connect(0, x + 1, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int i2 = 0; i2 < 105; i2++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                    connect(i2 * n + x + 1, (i2 + 1) * n + y + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    connect(i2 * n + y + 1, (i2 + 1) * n + x + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                connect(i * n + j + 1, (i + 1) * n + j + 1, 51, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
            connect(i * n + 1, 105 * n + 1, 51, 0);
        }

        int total_nodes = maxNodes;
        minCostMaxFlow(0, 105 * n + 1, total_nodes);
    }
}
